notes: Total 60 as published. Each posted line carries a deck-program rarity/set prefix (e.g. 'c U', 'z R', 'P NA'); the prefix is kept in the posted text and ignored for the dest.

Per the strategy the deck starts the Objective (pulling Secret Plans and Cloud City: West Gallery) and Prepared Defenses (pulling Mobilization Points or Battle Order, Imperial Arrest Order and Oppressive Enforcement); several Effects start, so starting.effect is left empty.

Posted 'We're In Attack Position Now - Admiral's Order x2' dested the Death Star II Admiral's Order We're In Attack Position Now; 'Sniper' is the A New Hope interrupt; 'Alter' the Premiere Dark interrupt; Secret Plans, Oppressive Enforcement and Battle Order are Effects (pre-Reflections III), not Defensive Shields.
The strategy says this form of the deck has gone 6-2 in tournament games; no event is named.
